input: one JSON object built by swot.swot_input() from the stored run: trend, stock, product, market (with sales-market-agent channel/content hypotheses and merchandising actions), limitations
output: one JSON object {strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats, promotions}; quadrants are lists of 0-4 {text, basis}, promotions a list of 0-3 {title, text, basis}, validated by swot.parse_swot()
